name: Pastel☆Nanana ~Mahou Shoujo wa Otoko no Ko!?~
original_name: ぱすてる☆ななな～魔法少女はオトコノコ!?～
source:
Soft skin, glossy long hair... getting envious stares from the girls, being forced to wear cute clothes, even receiving love letters from other guys! These are everyday events for the lead character Narumi Nanakawa. Suddenly, an angel named Liliy Lyndgren falls before him. Without realizing that he is a boy, she entrusts him with the mission of preserving justice in the world as an an angel substitute, Pastel Nanana!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041606.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
柔软的肌肤、亮泽的长发……被女生羡慕的目光、被强迫穿可爱的衣服、甚至收到男生的情书！这些是主角七川鸣海的日常事件。突然，一位名叫莉莉·林格伦的天使降临在他面前。不知不觉间，她就以天使替身帕斯特·纳纳纳的身份，将维护世界正义的使命托付给他！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041606.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
